requiredCorrections: Own a fixed marker-validated child and never delete the caller-supplied root or unrelated siblings.

Sanitize preservation and store errors before returning them to UI.

correctiveIndependentReview.correctiveAction: Expired outcomes now use the common post-cleanup return so a failed deletion is surfaced as CleanupPending. Cancellation remains OperationCanceledException and queues any failed deletion internally because no result object exists.

securityProperties.cleanupSemantics: Deletion is attempted and retried. Failures on returned outcomes are reported as CleanupPending. Cancellation propagates OperationCanceledException, so its cleanup state cannot be returned; any failure is queued internally. Pending paths are retried before later preservation and at startup. Physical secure erasure is not guaranteed.
